title: Restriction of modules to an open is left adjoint to the direct image
statement: Let $X$ be a topological space and $\mathcal O_X$ a sheaf of commutative rings on $X$, and let $U\subseteq X$ be an open subset. Write $\mathcal O_U=\mathcal O_X|_U$ for the sheaf of rings $W\mapsto\mathcal O_X(W)$ on the open subsets $W\subseteq U$, and for a sheaf of $\mathcal O_X$-modules $\mathcal M$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] write $\mathcal M|_U$ for the $\mathcal O_U$-module $W\mapsto\mathcal M(W)$ ($W\subseteq U$ open) with the restriction maps and module structures of $\mathcal M$ [def-weil-pbc-module-finite-type-presentation]; for a morphism $\alpha:\mathcal M\to\mathcal N$ of $\mathcal O_X$-modules let $\alpha|_U$ have the components $\alpha_W$, $W\subseteq U$. For a sheaf of $\mathcal O_U$-modules $\mathcal G$ let $j_*\mathcal G$ be the sheaf of $\mathcal O_X$-modules $V\mapsto\mathcal G(V\cap U)$ ($V\subseteq X$ open), with the restriction maps of $\mathcal G$ and with $\mathcal O_X(V)$ acting on $\mathcal G(V\cap U)$ through the restriction $\mathcal O_X(V)\to\mathcal O_X(V\cap U)=\mathcal O_U(V\cap U)$; for a morphism $\beta:\mathcal G\to\mathcal G'$ of $\mathcal O_U$-modules let $(j_*\beta)_V=\beta_{V\cap U}$. Then $\mathcal M\mapsto\mathcal M|_U$ and $\mathcal G\mapsto j_*\mathcal G$ are functors $\Mod(\mathcal O_X)\to\Mod(\mathcal O_U)$ and $\Mod(\mathcal O_U)\to\Mod(\mathcal O_X)$, and the first is left adjoint to the second: for all $\mathcal M\in\Mod(\mathcal O_X)$ and $\mathcal G\in\Mod(\mathcal O_U)$ the map $\Hom_{\mathcal O_U}(\mathcal M|_U,\mathcal G)\to\Hom_{\mathcal O_X}(\mathcal M,j_*\mathcal G)$ sending $\alpha$ to the morphism with components $\mathcal M(V)\to\mathcal G(V\cap U)$, $s\mapsto\alpha_{V\cap U}(s|_{V\cap U})$, is a bijection, natural in $\mathcal M$ and $\mathcal G$; its inverse sends $\beta$ to the morphism with components $\beta_W:\mathcal M(W)\to(j_*\mathcal G)(W)=\mathcal G(W)$ for $W\subseteq U$ open.

source.place: Sheaves, Lemma 0096 (sheaves-lemma-adjoint-pullback-pushforward-modules: f^* is left adjoint to f_* for a morphism of ringed spaces) applied to the inclusion j:(U,O_X|_U)->(X,O_X), with Lemma 00A0 (sheaves-lemma-j-pullback: j^{-1}G is V -> G(V) for V in U, also for sheaves of modules) and Definition 00A1 (sheaves-definition-restriction (3),(4)); for this j, j^*M = O_U (x)_{j^{-1}O_X} j^{-1}M = j^{-1}M = M|_U since j^{-1}O_X = O_U; the pushforward is Definition 0095 (sheaves-definition-pushforward)

proof.text: Use Mathlib SheafOfModules.overPushforwardOverAdj U, specialized to R = moduleRings X. Its left functor pushforward (identity on R.over U) is definitionally SheafOfModules.overFunctor R U, and its right functor is exactly pushforward (pushforwardOver U). This supplies the required adjunction with the existing sectionwise restriction and direct-image functors.

For the forward formula, unfold Adjunction.homEquiv: it composes the unit with the image of alpha under the right adjoint. In overPushforwardOverAdj the unit on V sends s to M.val.map (prod.snd).op s, and the right-adjoint map evaluates alpha at (Over.star U).obj V. The asserted formula is definitional equality, proved by rfl.

For the inverse formula, unfold the inverse of Adjunction.homEquiv: it composes the restriction of beta with the counit. The restriction evaluates beta at W.left; the counit acts by G.val.map ((Over.forgetAdjStar U).unit.app W).op. This is again the asserted formula by rfl. The inverse laws and naturality are already part of Mathlib’s adjunction, so no separate section-functor or transpose lemma is needed.

lean.statement: theorem exists_openRestrictionAdjunction (X : RingedSpace.{u}) (U : Opens X) : ∃ adj : SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{w} (moduleRings X) U ⊣ SheafOfModules.pushforward.{w} (SheafOfModules.pushforwardOver (R := moduleRings X) U), (∀ (M : SheafOfModules.{w} (moduleRings X)) (G : SheafOfModules.{w} ((moduleRings X).over U)) (α : M.over U ⟶ G) (V : Opens X) (s : M.val.obj (op V)), ((adj.homEquiv M G) α).val.app (op V) s = α.val.app (op ((Over.star U).obj V)) (M.val.map (prod.snd : U ⨯ V ⟶ V).op s)) ∧ (∀ (M : SheafOfModules.{w} (moduleRings X)) (G : SheafOfModules.{w} ((moduleRings X).over U)) (β : M ⟶ (SheafOfModules.pushforward (SheafOfModules.pushforwardOver U)).obj G) (W : Over U) (s : M.val.obj (op W.left)), ((adj.homEquiv M G).symm β).val.app (op W) s = G.val.map ((Over.forgetAdjStar U).unit.app W).op (β.val.app (op W.left) s))
lean.note: The open subspace is encoded by the equivalent site Over U (opens of X contained in U). The existing overFunctor and pushforward along Over.star give the two sectionwise functors; the theorem specifies both directions of the natural hom-set equivalence, including canonical identification of U ∩ W with W.
